notes.sowing: Sow {cm:1.3} deep from 2 weeks before your last frost, or start indoors 4 to 6 weeks ahead and plant out around the last frost. Each seed is a cluster that sends up several seedlings, so thin to the strongest.
notes.care: Chard does not bolt from heat or long days, but growth slows in midsummer and picks up again when it cools. Water through dry spells. A cold snap soon after planting out can make young plants bolt, so harden them off well.
notes.harvest: Pick outer leaves at the base of the stalk and leave the center to keep producing. Plants stand light frosts and crop until a hard freeze.
